pages.title: Claim It First
pages.text: The puppet is non-stacking. Use an unbound one in air to claim it; the tooltip then shows owner, Respawn Anchor, and durability. It shares the personal realm's persistent identity. Valid legacy UUID migration changes only owner, not durability or anchor.

pages.title: Recharge with Nurturing Crystals
pages.text: Hold the puppet in the offhand and use Nurturing Crystals from the other hand. Every 8 restore 1 durability, consuming as many complete sets as possible until materials run out or durability reaches 16.

pages.title: Substitution Trigger
pages.text: When the owner dies, a puppet in inventory, Kongqiao, or Xianqiao storage immediately applies the Totem of Undying effect and spends 1 durability. The activation shows the puppet itself and has no extra cooldown.

pages.title: Bind the Destination
pages.text: Use the held puppet on a Respawn Anchor to record a cross-dimensional destination. Rescue teleports there without cheat permission. Use in air to clear it; breaking or exploding the anchor clears it automatically. Another player cannot rebind it.
